mapper.select: SELECT ar.id, ar.alert_no AS alertNo, ar.rule_id AS ruleId, ar.rule_name AS ruleName, ar.device_id AS deviceId, ar.device_code AS deviceCode, ar.device_name AS deviceName, ar.plot_id AS plotId, ar.plot_name AS plotName, ar.alert_level AS alertLevel, CASE ar.alert_level WHEN 1 THEN '紧急' WHEN 2 THEN '重要' WHEN 3 THEN '一般' WHEN 4 THEN '提醒' ELSE '未知' END AS alertLevelText, ar.property_code AS propertyCode, ar.property_name AS propertyName, ar.trigger_value AS triggerValue, ar.threshold_value AS thresholdValue, ar.alert_content AS alertContent, ar.alert_time AS alertTime, ar.handle_status AS handleStatus, CASE ar.handle_status WHEN 1 THEN '待处理' WHEN 2 THEN '处理中' WHEN 3 THEN '已处理' WHEN 4 THEN '已忽略' ELSE '未知' END AS handleStatusText, ar.handle_time AS handleTime, ar.handle_user AS handleUser, ar.handle_result AS handleResult, ar.create_time AS createTime FROM agri_iot_alert_record ar WHERE ar.id = #{id} AND ar.del_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_iot_alert_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND handle_status = 1

SELECT ar.id, ar.alert_no AS alertNo, ar.rule_name AS ruleName, ar.device_code AS deviceCode, ar.device_name AS deviceName, ar.alert_level AS alertLevel, CASE ar.alert_level WHEN 1 THEN '紧急' WHEN 2 THEN '重要' WHEN 3 THEN '一般' WHEN 4 THEN '提醒' ELSE '未知' END AS alertLevelText, ar.alert_content AS alertContent, ar.alert_time AS alertTime, ar.handle_status AS handleStatus, CASE ar.handle_status WHEN 1 THEN '待处理' WHEN 2 THEN '处理中' WHEN 3 THEN '已处理' WHEN 4 THEN '已忽略' ELSE '未知' END AS handleStatusText FROM agri_iot_alert_record ar WHERE ar.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY ar.alert_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
